item.title: 🔴 Canvas Breach Disrupts Schools & Colleges Nationwide
item.description:
Why this matters: Potential exposure of credentials/data; check monitoring and incident readiness.
An ongoing data extortion attack targeting the widely-used education technology platform Canvas disrupted classes and coursework at school districts and universities across the United States today, after a cybercrime group defaced the service's login page with a ransom demand that threatened to leak data from 275 million students and faculty across nearly 9,000 educational institutions.

Source: Krebs on Security   Severity: Critical

item.title: 🔴 Canvas login portals hacked in mass ShinyHunters extortion campaign

item.title: 🔴 Ivanti EPMM CVE-2026-6973 RCE Under Active Exploitation Grants Admin-Level Access
item.description:
Why this matters: Leadership context; useful for risk/budget/vendor conversations.

The high-severity vulnerability, CVE-2026-6973 (CVSS score: 7.2), is a case of improper input validation affecting EPMM before versions 12.6.1.1, 12.7.0.1, and 12.8.0.1. Source: The Hacker News   Severity: Critical
